name: Work UK
description: A national benchmark survey dataset capturing attitudes to work across the UK population for comparison and monitoring over time.
evaluation_method: descriptive statistics / regression and hypothesis testing (statistical analysis)
reputation: A national survey dataset used in UK social science research for monitoring attitudes to work, with moderate recognition among social researchers.
notes: Survey data (non-LLM) with potential sensitive personal information and sampling/weighting requirements to obtain representative estimates; not a conventional ML benchmark — tasks depend on chosen analytic framing (e.g., classification/regression), and caution is required for privacy and ethical use.
